stem: Voltmarkt's CRM manager asks: "Which of our known customers used to buy often but have not ordered for a long time, so we can send them a win-back offer?" Which calculation answers this question?

options.text: 100 × customers with 2 or more orders / customers with 1 or more
Score each customer on recency, frequency and spend, then group
Expected gross profit from a customer over the whole relationship
